scope: 100 ns startup diagnostic only; smooths nominal input bias with 1 uV scale; not a calibrated model or board qualification
solverDiagnostics: doAnalyses: TRAN:  Timestep too small; time = 1.00445e-11, timestep = 2.79214e-21: trouble with node "vhost#branch"
interpretation: Smoothing the input-bias knee alone did not resolve startup. The solver named the host supply branch; this does not identify the root cause.
diagnosticModel:
* Exploratory LS-TTL NAND macromodel, NOT a calibrated DL000 model.
* Nominal parameters below are assumptions, not extracted die/device data.
* Validated only as a transport/topology experiment; supply current is not modeled.
.subckt LS_NAND_NOMINAL a b y vp g params: threshold=1.4 width=0.1 pole=5n rout=30 cin=3p
* Continuous transfer; no artificial Schmitt hysteresis or clock source.
Btarget target g V=V(vp,g)*(0.04+0.66*(1-(1+tanh((V(a,g)-threshold)/width))*(1+tanh((V(b,g)-threshold)/width))/4))
Rpole target filtered 1k
Cpole filtered g {pole/1000}
Edrive drive g filtered g 1
Rout drive y {rout}
Ca a g {cin}
Cb b g {cin}
* Illustrative low-input bias and negative-input clamps.
Bia vp a I=((0.32*V(vp,g)-V(a,g))+sqrt((0.32*V(vp,g)-V(a,g))*(0.32*V(vp,g)-V(a,g))+1e-12))/20000
Bib vp b I=((0.32*V(vp,g)-V(b,g))+sqrt((0.32*V(vp,g)-V(b,g))*(0.32*V(vp,g)-V(b,g))+1e-12))/20000
Da g a INPUT_CLAMP_NOMINAL
Db g b INPUT_CLAMP_NOMINAL
.model INPUT_CLAMP_NOMINAL D(IS=1e-14 N=1 RS=20)
.ends LS_NAND_NOMINAL
